recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The seed issue is correctly represented in the current build; replacing the legacy word 'extension' in the enableWhen comment with 'element' would be a small editorial cleanup, not a required FHIR-26993 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-26993 asked to clarify Questionnaire.item.enableWhen so readers would not infer that multiple enableWhen clauses are always ORed, and to point readers to enableBehavior while explaining that a referenced multi-answer question satisfies the condition if any answer matches.
initial_application: The Jira comment records commit 1809c5dcba1f414b2beba75c38296e8c43857c5d, whose subject appears to typo the issue number as FHIR-26933 but whose patch replaced the old OR wording with explicit enableBehavior text and the any-answer rule. Commit 5665c38fcfbab7630b6f50f421947fcf41581117 for related issue FHIR-26312 later added the same any-answer rule to Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x].
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The originating Zulip thread shows the confusion was exactly between enableBehavior for multiple enableWhen clauses and matching any answer of a repeating question, and Confluence SDC minutes record the FHIR-26993 Persuasive vote. FHIR-26831, also mentioned in that thread, is a separate que-12 threshold correction and already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml already states that multiple enableWhen repetitions are interpreted by enableBehavior, that any matching answer satisfies an enableWhen against a multi-answer referenced question, and that enableBehavior must be present when more than one enableWhen is supplied.

related_jiras.note: Same Questionnaire enableWhen area; it independently clarified repeating items and added the multiple-answer rule to enableWhen.answer[x].
Same Zulip thread identified the separate que-12 enableBehavior threshold issue; it is already represented on the combined branch as 821deda474540ef19ecc70fdf18ac91f0d8b5517.
